day_shape: 72 items: IDF confirms killing of Hamas military chief Mohammed Odeh in Gaza strike, IRGC-affiliated Defa Press claims a US-Iran MoU framework draft (White House calls it 'complete fabrication'), CENTCOM says 109 vessels redirected under naval blockade, Tyre and Nabatiyeh evacuation warnings ahead of 150+ strikes on Hezbollah.

threads.label: Hamas military chief killed in Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet announced the killing of Mohammed Odeh, head of Hamas's military wing, in a strike on buildings in northern Gaza City, with Defence Minister Israel Katz confirming the operation. Hamas confirmed Odeh's death and held a funeral in Gaza City; Defa Press carried a Hamas statement that the assassinations would strengthen its resistance.

threads.label: Reported US-Iran MoU draft and denial
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB said a preliminary informal framework for a US-Iran MoU had been published, under which Washington would lift its naval blockade in exchange for Iran returning Hormuz commercial transits to pre-tension levels. The White House called the Iranian report a 'complete fabrication'; Trump told a cabinet meeting Iran 'very much wanted' a deal but the US was 'not yet satisfied', and ruled out sanctions relief for highly enriched uranium.

threads.label: Iran diplomatic outreach on war
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB reported Foreign Minister Araghchi held calls with French counterpart Jean-Noël Barrot and New Zealand's Winston Peters on ending what they termed the imposed war, and sent Eid al-Adha messages to foreign ministers of Islamic states. Defa Press also quoted Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi saying any US-Iran agreement should go to the UN Security Council, while the Jerusalem Post reported China urged ceasefire commitment.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and US naval blockade
threads.summary: CENTCOM said 109 commercial vessels had been redirected under the US blockade of Iran as of 27 May, with MH-60R patrols from USS Delbert D. Black in the Arabian Sea and carrier operations aboard USS Abraham Lincoln. IRGC outlets said 23 ships transited Hormuz in 24 hours with Sepah coordination, and South Korea's Foreign Ministry said an Iranian anti-ship missile was likely involved in an earlier attack on an HMM cargo ship in the strait.

threads.label: Lebanon strikes and evacuation warnings
threads.summary: IDF Arabic spokesperson Avichay Adraee said forces struck more than 150 Hezbollah infrastructure sites in Tyre, Nabatiyeh and the Bekaa over 24 hours and issued evacuation warnings for Tyre, Nabatiyeh and named villages south of the Litani. Hezbollah claimed strikes on a Merkava tank, a personnel carrier and four troop gathering points and drone attacks in northern Israel; Defa Press claimed a settler died in a Shumir drone strike, and Times of Israel said the IDF dismissed Hezbollah's reported clashes north of the Litani.

threads.label: Khamenei messaging and Eid mobilisation
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published a message stating the 'Zionist regime' had 'at most fifteen years' left, citing a Khomeini prediction, and announced commemorations for family members listed as martyrs. IRIB ran Eid al-Adha prayer footage from Urmia and claims by acting Defence Minister Ibn al-Rida that the armed forces had inflicted a 'historic defeat' on the US and Israel.

threads.label: Israeli military build-up and Iran-related security
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported the US delivered Israel the first of at least six KC-46 midair refuelling aircraft, described as enabling future strikes on Iran and distant targets, and said the Pentagon contracted Raytheon for $1 billion in NASAMS air defence systems for Kuwait. A National Crime Unit Lahav 433 officer was questioned over suspected contact with a foreign agent likely Iranian, and the IDF said it killed via an IAF strike the gunman who shot Major (res.) Itamar Sapir near a church.
